label.say: This line is wrapped in the file and indented on both sides, so it must read as a single line with one space between "read" and "as".
An explicit break follows this colon: and this continues on the next line.
A space before a style element survives: I like this dress, and these jeans with red stitching.
Preformatted: this CDATA block keeps its break and its indentation.
Tabs between words are kept because they span no line break.
